correctness.rationale: The family Te is uniformly recursively enumerable. Totality of phi_e makes every added Sigma_1 halting axiom true, so Te is Sigma_1-sound; nontotality inserts a false Sigma_1 axiom. Lengyel Theorem 4 converts exactly this soundness split into extensional equality versus the universal generated composition congruence. A direct search-program reduction from an arbitrary Pi_2 predicate proves Pi_2-hardness of the extensional endpoint, while the displayed forall-exists halting form proves membership.
